Coal worker's pneumoconiosis: Coal dust — Coal miners — Small upper-zone nodules, progressive massive fibrosis, Caplan syndrome (rheumatoid arthritis + nodules)

Patients can either present with simple (nodular) silicosis or progressive massive fibrosis (PMF).\nPatients with simple silicosis can be asymptomatic, while those with progressive massive fibrosis may have signs and symptoms of chronic respiratory failure.
Silicotic nodules may coalesce to form conglomerate fibrotic masses (> 1 cm ), leading to the development of Progressive Massive Fibrosis.
The nodules may be​come confluent with progressive massive fibrosis.\nPneumoco​nioses such as silicosis lead to restrictive lung disease.
These masses can\nbecome quite large and coalesce to progressive massive fibrosis.
